class.name: AudioCommands
class.brief_description: A collection of [AudioCommand]s, savable as one CSV row per command.
class.description: An [AudioCommands] holds the audio commands of a soundboard, a level's ambience or a whole game. Edit it in the Inspector, save it as [code].tres[/code], JSON, INI or CSV, and register it with [method AudioMixerServer.register_commands] or in the project setting [code]audio/mixer/default_commands[/code]. [method AudioMixerServer.execute_commands] runs all of its commands once. [b]Note:[/b] This class was called [code]AudioCommandList[/code] before 0.2.2. The old name is deprecated: saved resources with the old type still load as [AudioCommands], but scripts must use the new name. As CSV, the header row names the [AudioCommand] properties and each further row is one command; columns that all commands leave at the default are omitted, and missing cells keep the default. A CSV has no type of its own, so load it with a type hint: [codeblocks] [gdscript] var board = ResourceLoader.load("res://audio/soundboard.csv", "AudioCommands") board.preload_streams() # No loading hitch on the first button press. AudioMixerServer.register_commands(board) [/gdscript] [csharp] var board = ResourceLoader.Load<AudioCommands>("res://audio/soundboard.csv", "AudioCommands"); board.PreloadStreams(); // No loading hitch on the first button press. AudioMixerServer.RegisterCommands(board); [/csharp] [/codeblocks] A soundboard file can look like this: [codeblock lang=text] command_name,channel,command,stream_path horn,pad_1,Toggle,res://sounds/horn.wav drums,pad_2,Toggle,res://sounds/drums.ogg [/codeblock]

method.name: clear_preloaded_streams
method.description: Releases the streams kept by [method preload_streams]. Streams that still play stay in memory until they end.

method.name: find_command
method.description: Returns the first command whose [member AudioCommand.command_name] is [param name], or [code]null[/code] if there is none.

method.name: get_preloaded_stream_count
method.description: Returns the number of different streams kept by [method preload_streams].

method.name: preload_streams
method.description: Loads the [member AudioCommand.stream_path] of every command now and keeps the streams in memory while this resource exists (or until [method clear_preloaded_streams]), so the first [method AudioMixerServer.execute] of a command does not load from disk. Streams already in the resource cache are shared, not loaded twice. Loads all streams it can; returns the first error and prints one message if a file is missing or not an [AudioStream]. [b]Note:[/b] On the Web (single-threaded), loading blocks the frame; call this method behind a loading screen.

members.member: The commands, in the order [method AudioMixerServer.execute_commands] runs them and [method AudioMixerServer.register_commands] registers them.
